Reason: The CT images demonstrate a hyperdense, metallic-attenuation object (measured at ~425 HU) lodged within the right lower lobe bronchus, accompanied by distal lung collapse (atelectasis). This finding is diagnostic of a foreign body aspiration causing obstructive atelectasis.
